payload.text: WP11 commit 3 (vc's ruling 25f85e7) is in progress, uncommitted and unmeasured, in cc's scratchpad clone /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Pplr/f3516df3-3c28-4ed2-820f-b9b34ea2e5f8/scratchpad/wp11 (based on 25f85e7), not in the shared tree. Done there: tests/cli.rs gains sync_refuses_a_missing_value_or_a_bad_limit_and_writes_nothing (written, not yet run); src/workbook.rs splits decisions() into a calamine read and a pure reviewed() with a Mistake enum and two unit tests (an inserted column, a missing header), reviewed() still reading by position so both tests can run red first. Not started: options() refusing a missing value and a bad --limit, the header lookup, the Decision and Confidence enums, card_change(), Person.picture (which also retires tags.rs's picture_of), the pure matches() with check() probing the inetlocs, marker_paths, write_each, one Format per column. The clone survives a compact, not a reboot. Order (vc, after the compact): whichever of commit 3 and dc's WP14 is ready first lands first, and the other rebases onto it and measures once; WP14 is likely first, so commit 3 then rebases its tests/cli.rs block (the only shared file) onto WP14.
